text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 3) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 8 Ogos 2012.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 8 Ogos 2012 hingga 9 Jun 2013.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

[Perenggan 2]

Semua jenis mentega

Semua jenis keju

Semua jenis marjerin

Semua jenis minuman kotak atau botol

Semua jenis serbuk penaik dan esen membuat kuih-muih dan konfeksi

Jeli dan agar-agar

Daging dan bahagian dalam mentah-segar atau dijeruk

Itik dan burung-burung lain, kecuali ayam

Telur belum berkupas kulit dan telur dijeruk

Buah-buahan mentah yang diimport-segar atau dijeruk

Bawang besar dan bawang merah

Bawang putih

Cili kering

Lada hitam dan semua jenis rempah

Kelapa, sebiji atau yang diparut

Semua jenis kacang

Semua jenis kacang tanah

Cendawan dan kulat

Minyak sapi

Asam jawa

Makanan laut yang dikeringkan atau dijeruk

Tepung beras

Tepung jagung

Tepung beras pulut

Ubi kentang

Dibuat 7 Ogos 2012

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VII]

 DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

 Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

 Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 3) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 3) Order 2012.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 8 August 2012.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 8 August 2012 to 9 June 2013.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

[Paragraph 2]

All types of butter

All types of cheese

All types of margarine

All types of packed or bottled drinks

All types of baking powder and essences for making cakes and confectionery

Jelly and agar-agar

Raw meat and offal-fresh or preserved

Duck and other birds, excluding chicken

Eggs in the shell and preserved eggs

Raw imported fruits-fresh or preserved

Onion and shallots

Garlic

Dried chillies

Black pepper and all types of spices

Coconuts, whole or scraped

All types of peas and beans

All types of groundnuts

Mushroom and fungi

Ghee

Tamarind

Dried or preserved seafood

Rice flour

Corn flour

Glutinous rice flour

Potatoes

Made 7 August 2012

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VII]

DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

 Minister of Domestic Trade,

 Co-operatives and Consumerism
